text:
Erik Gustafsson is on his ninth NHL team, and Los Angeles may be getting the best version of him. He has eight points in 14 games, four on the power play, and the Kings control play when he is out there: 56.7% of the 5v5 expected goals (the quality of chances), 8.2 points better than without him.

He has also been in and out. He missed several games this month as day-to-day, then came back in Boston and scored a goal and an assist in a win. That makes the sample smaller than it looks, so treat his points rate (1.71 per 60) with caution; our range for him sits closer to 1.31.

The profile is a puck-moving power-play defenseman who also keeps the other end quiet, which is not how his reputation reads. Evolving-Hockey's most recent full season for him, 2024-25, had him 88th among 222 defensemen, with most of his value from even-strength defense. He is 34 and was a fourth-round pick, and he keeps finding work. A 20-minute defenseman who moves the puck is a real find.
